package.name: global_plan_navigate_bridge
package.description: Adapter from a topic-publishing global planner (nav_msgs/Path on global_plan) to the task-executor local planner: each new plan becomes a NavigateTask goal (cancel-then-resend), so planners that only publish paths (exploration_planner, raven) can drive a task-executor local planner such as droan_gl (asm_droan).
